_about: Copy to answers.json and replace every value with yours (the setup prompt does this with you). Values marked EXAMPLE are rule examples: replace them or write a neutral sentence. PERSONALISE.md explains each key. fill_placeholders.py derives WORKSPACE, MEMORY_KEY, FIRST_NAME, FILE_STEM, USER_HOME, CONTACT_LINE and CAMPAIGN_FILE_STEM if you leave them out.
LANGUAGES_LINE: French and English, both working languages
EXCLUDED_ORGS: no organisation (EXAMPLE: list here any organisation you must never apply to)
SEARCH_FIELDS: Mechanical design, manufacturing, materials testing, energy, R&D
NEVER_MENTION: any result you do not want to discuss (EXAMPLE: replace or write none)
KEY_RESULTS_STORY: EXAMPLE: your strongest project rests on your own work: name its two or three key numbers here.
MY_REPORTS: EXAMPLE: your project and internship reports in ..\my documents\reports and projects\
PREP_MODEL: the first interview prep you are happy with (none yet: follow this section as written)
DECK_MODEL: the first deck you edit yourself (none yet: the slide set of build_deck.js as it is)
DECK_NOTE_EXAMPLE: Example: "The main result held across every sample //the spread stayed small, which we traced to the preparation step//."
DECK_SPEC_PROJECTS: which project comes first (a key of profile_deck.json projects)
HOST_BRIEF_EXAMPLE: (EXAMPLE: as a host may ask for a 10-minute talk)
FIELD_CHOICE_QUESTION: Why this field and not a neighbouring one
FAILURE_QUESTION: What I would do if the main experiment or prototype does not work
TECHNIQUE_ABBREV_EXAMPLE: the English / French abbreviation of one of my techniques
SKETCH_SHAPES: a spectrum with peaks or bands, a curve over time, a response curve, a calibration line
SKETCH_AXES_EXAMPLE: for example x = time in s, y = signal in its unit
SKETCH_FEATURES_EXAMPLE: a peak, a slope, a threshold
READING_EXAMPLE: a shift, a broader peak, a new feature, a steeper slope
NOTEBOOKLM_MODEL: the first NOTEBOOKLM_PROMPT.txt you are happy with (none yet: follow this section as written)
FORM_SALARY: paid position, no figure (FR: stage rémunéré, sans montant)
